account_changes_roster_revision.name: account_changes_roster_revision
account_changes_roster_revision.where:
((action = 'invite' and status = 'succeeded' and source_key is not null)
  or (action = 'remove' and status in ('succeeded', 'done_by_hand')))

account_changes_connection_or_no_connect.name: account_changes_connection_or_no_connection
account_changes_connection_or_no_connect.value: "account_changes"."connection_id" is not null or ("account_changes"."error" is not null and "account_changes"."error" = 'no_connection')

app_accounts_employee_link.name: app_accounts_employee_link
app_accounts_employee_link.value:
("app_accounts"."employee_id" is null) = ("app_accounts"."employee_linked_by" is null)
      and ("app_accounts"."employee_linked_by" is null or ("app_accounts"."kind" = 'personal' and "app_accounts"."employee_linked_by" in ('email','owner')))
